requete: requete('47G3355', evenement(v(e), upholster))
texte: Set in a workshop interior, the painting shows a craftsman in an apron stretching damask fabric over the padded seat of an armchair. He secures the material with small tacks, hammered one after another along the frame, while horsehair stuffing lies scattered on the floor at his feet. The artist dwells on the materials of the trade: the sheen of the damask contrasts with the coarse fibres below, and the rhythm of the tacks gives structure to the gesture. Scenes of skilled manual labour of this kind enjoyed considerable favour among nineteenth-century genre painters, who found in the artisan's absorbed concentration a subject at once modest and dignified.

texte: An allegorical judge lifts her blindfold in order to favour one of the litigants. She lets a purse tip one pan of her balance and turns her back on the poor plaintiff.
